trusted_sections: Work Package PX0-03 - Control Router + Activity
Task 6: Add bounded Activity Log and normalized control states
Task 7: Add DebugControlRouter for product, Axiom-debug, and Surface owners
Task 8: Retire the generic Debug UI command queue

trusted_statements.objective: Introduce one Debug UI control router and bounded activity log, route existing Debug UI control intents to their owning product/engineering contracts, observe asynchronous engineering receipt transitions, and retire the duplicate generic debug_ui command queue.
owner_boundaries: Product behavior routes only through RuntimeFacade.
Axiom engineering actions route only through AxiomDebugControl.
Canonical Surface engineering mode routes only through PlatformDebugControl.
Product UI does not depend on DebugControlRouter.
DebugControlRouter contains adaptation/routing only and must not own feature business logic.

router_context.request_ids: Router-local monotonically increasing non-zero request IDs.
router_context.begin_frame: beginFrame(snapshot) freezes the Debug UI request context for the frame: runtime/document/surface identity, sequence, frameId, selection count, and primary selection.
router_context.deadline: Debug UI-originated queued owner requests use current snapshot stamp.sequence + 120.
router_context.generation_fencing: Axiom requests use runtime/document generation from the current frame; Surface requests use canonical Surface generation from Platform diagnostics when present, otherwise snapshot surfaceGeneration.

product_routing.setBrush: Use RuntimeFacade product control only; no Axiom/Platform owner and no platform-specific profile string inside the router.
product_routing.camera: Pan/Zoom/Fit route through RuntimeFacade product control only.
product_routing.setTool: For the current legacy Pan selector, setTool accepts the underlying CanvasToolKind numeric value and submits a typed CanvasControl request through RuntimeFacade so the existing CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter/CanvasControlService lane remains valid.
product_routing.fit_selection_guard: Fit Selection with selectedObjectCount == 0 returns a local Rejected ProductControlReceipt and does not call RuntimeFacade or fall back to Fit Content.
product_routing.fit_primary_guard: Fit Primary Object with primaryObject == 0 returns a local Rejected ProductControlReceipt and does not call RuntimeFacade.

activity_contract.semantics: The activity log stores bounded Debug UI-originated request/receipt transitions, not canonical Operations and not Gate evidence.
activity_contract.transition_model: A new bounded activity entry is appended for admission and for each observed terminal transition; oldest entries are discarded when capacity is exceeded.
activity_contract.compatibility: DebugActivitySnapshot may retain the PX0-02 latest ProductControlReceipt and SurfaceModeReceipt fields while adding normalized bounded entries, so current tabs remain source-compatible until the Workbench migration.

receipt_refresh: refreshReceipts polls only outstanding queued AxiomDebug and PlatformDebug requests.
Queued receipts remain outstanding; terminal receipts append a normalized transition and are removed from the outstanding set.
Receipt refresh must not re-read Runtime/Axiom/Arc/Platform/Telemetry diagnostics.
PlatformDebugControl gains a read-only receipt(requestId) query with a source-compatible default Unsupported result.
integration: DebugActivityLog implements DebugActivitySource and becomes the activity provider supplied to DebugSnapshotAssembler on Windows and Web.

Capture flow is: assembler.capture -> router.beginFrame -> router.refreshReceipts -> replace snapshot.activity with activityLog.snapshot -> publish/render. Receipt refresh does not cause a second diagnostics capture.
Existing Debug UI controls migrate to DebugControlRouter where the equivalent typed intent already exists: Selection, Undo/Redo, Brush, Eraser, Pan tool, and Surface mode.
buildImGuiPanels no longer receives RuntimeFacade/AxiomDebugControl/PlatformDebugControl pointers directly; it receives DebugControlRouter.
Axiom routing is implemented and tested but PX0-03 does not add new Workbench controls merely to expose it.
WindowsDebugUiHost may temporarily retain legacy owner setter fields until PX0-06, but panel rendering must not use them after PX0-03.
preserved_boundaries: PX0-02 structured DebugSnapshot and common DebugSnapshotAssembler remain the observation boundary.
RuntimeFacade/IAxiomDiagnostics split from PX0-01 remains unchanged.
CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter and CanvasControlService remain valid product-control infrastructure.
Current fixed tab layout remains until PX0-04.
Existing capability migration and full Debug UI control surface remains PX0-05.

forbidden_interpretations: DebugControlRouter is not a product business-logic owner.
PX0-03 does not authorize new Shape/RichText/Connector/Snap/Image semantics.
PX0-03 does not authorize Workbench, WorkspaceId, PanelRegistry, PanelSlot, or final panel extension architecture.
PX0-03 does not authorize Preview repair, physical qualification, or Gate PASS claims.
The bounded activity log is not canonical history, telemetry persistence, or evidence storage.
